text: {"lessons":["I should not let reluctance to admit a purchase was a mistake keep me invested; I can reassess each holding on its merits.","I made no trades, and my account fell substantially over these periods, so I should review whether my holdings and risk level still suit me rather than simply standing by.","Past price changes do not predict future changes, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and make decisions based on my goals and risk tolerance."]}
